BiblicalUsage: Neiel is named once, as a place on the border of Asher, where the boundary turns toward the sunrise. It stands where Asher's land meets Zebulun's, a marker on the edge of the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the careful borders matter: God gave each tribe its own ground, and a place on the line was worth naming in the record.
